zones.installation_description: A pre-war emergency fuel reserve, sealed beneath a collapsed factory. The maps show a maintenance access through the old sewer junction.

fragments.label: Northern Sector
fragments.description: Shows the factory district north of the river. Burn damage obscures the eastern edge.

fragments.label: Sewer Grid
fragments.description: A pre-war sewer system map. The junction at sector C-7 is circled in red ink.

fragments.label: Fuel Reserve Key
fragments.description: A key card with an access code. Someone wrote 'DEPOT — EMERGENCY ONLY' across the back.

zones.installation_description: A community seed bank hidden in the basement of the old library. The vault is intact — seeds may still be viable.

fragments.label: Library Blueprint
fragments.description: Architectural plans for the old public library. A basement level is shown that doesn't appear on public records.

fragments.label: Librarian's Note
fragments.description: A handwritten note: 'Vault code is the date of the first seed catalog. Ask Margaret. She'll remember.'

zones.installation_description: An unmarked military installation beneath a decommissioned radar station. The armory may still contain pre-war weapons and EMP-hardened equipment.

fragments.label: Radar Station Exterior
fragments.description: A survey map of the old radar station. The main building is marked as 'condemned' but the substructure notes say 'active.'

fragments.label: Elevator Access
fragments.description: A service elevator schematic. The control panel requires a code — the fragment shows digits 7, 4, and 9, but the rest is water-damaged.

fragments.label: Supply Manifest
fragments.description: A quartermaster's manifest: 'Armory 7 — Full Stock. EMP-hardened equipment. Authorization code: CHIMERA-7-4-9.'

zones.installation_description: Sub-surface tactical command center buried beneath pulverized basalt and ionizing fallout. Heavy lead-shielded blast doors.

fragments.label: Hypocenter Thermal Survey
fragments.description: Infrared survey overlay showing reinforced sub-structures surviving under the ground-zero vitrification ring.

fragments.label: Conduit Routing Diagram
fragments.description: High-voltage armored cable conduits tracing from the substation directly into the core blast basin.

fragments.label: Dead-Hand Frequency Card
fragments.description: Laminated card giving the primary beacon interrogation signal for emergency automated vault entry.

zones.installation_description: Submerged maritime relay station situated past the tidal locks. Watertight bulkhead entries accessible at low slack tide.

fragments.label: Bathymetric Sounding Chart
fragments.description: Nautical chart indicating an artificial underwater trench excavated before the war for intake lines.

fragments.label: Tidal Lock Manual
fragments.description: Hand-annotated operational manual for Lock Gate Four, indicating sluice bypass timing.

zones.installation_description: Cliffside communications shelter hidden behind an avalanche gallery scree fall. Preserves intact antenna arrays.

fragments.label: Switchback Elevation Map
fragments.description: Topographical map showing concealed maintenance adits carved into the granite rockface.

fragments.label: Surveyor's Log Extract
fragments.description: Field notes from a pre-war cartographer referencing a subterranean cable vault above the snowline.

zones.installation_description: A municipal hospital expansion converted into a protected casualty intake annex shortly before the Exchange. Street entrances collapsed in the first winter, but a service stair beneath the older wing may still be walkable. The intake ledgers were never removed.

fragments.label: Ambulance Approach
fragments.description: A scorched street plan with emergency-lane arrows still legible. Someone circled a service entrance behind the old wing and wrote 'decon first' in the margin.

fragments.label: Utility Basement
fragments.description: A water-bloomed engineering sheet showing an isolated stairwell and two negative-pressure rooms. A pencil note reads 'keep clear — intake route'.

fragments.label: Casualty Routing
fragments.description: A torn triage overlay, grease-stained along one fold. Its colored arrows only make sense laid over the street plan and the utility sheet.

zones.installation_description: A courthouse evidence store sunk below the record halls, inventoried to the box and sealed for the evacuation. The freight lift was stripped for its copper, but the custody ledgers list every shelf that was never claimed.

fragments.label: Property Index
fragments.description: A index card sheet mapping case numbers to sub-basement shelving rows. Coffee rings blur the later entries; row K stays readable.

fragments.label: Service Corridor
fragments.description: A fire-escape plan of the courthouse showing a records corridor that appears on no public floor plan. Mold spots the margin.

fragments.label: Transfer Sheet
fragments.description: A typed transfer authorization, corner torn. 'Sub-basement, row K — hold until trial or dissolution.' A clerk's initials follow.

zones.installation_description: A sealed feed-and-herd quarantine barn stood off from the valley farms, built for the veterinary service and forgotten when the collective folded. The lime-stoned floor was meant to keep infection in; it may have kept the weather out instead.

fragments.label: Herd Ledger
fragments.description: A veterinary ledger page listing quarantine rotations. A hand-drawn barn sketch in the back shows a lane that bypasses the main yard.

fragments.label: Irrigation Run
fragments.description: A faded parcel map of the valley fields, folded to death along the lane lines. The quarantine lane is inked over in a different hand: 'service only'.

zones.installation_description: A fire-crew supply cache bermed into a slope off the logging spur, stocked against a bad season that arrived in a different form. The compartment grid was standard forestry practice; the location survived only in crew paperwork.

fragments.label: Firebreak Seven
fragments.description: A compartment map of the firebreaks with bearing marks in greasy pencil. Firebreak Seven is scored out and re-marked 'cache side'.

fragments.label: Logging Spur
fragments.description: A survey of the spur line east of the river, salt-stained from a winter in a cab pocket. A distance wheel annotation marks a pull-off below the bluffs.

fragments.label: Emergency Cache Grid
fragments.description: A printed cache-grid form, never filed. The crew foreman's initials approve stocking for 'two crews, one season'.

zones.installation_description: A restricted materials laboratory beneath the teaching block, reached through freight corridors rather than the campus proper. Equipment transfer sheets suggest the removal crews never finished the sublevel before the roads closed.

fragments.label: Teaching Wing
fragments.description: A campus orientation map, fold-abraded, with the teaching wing's service stair circled and labeled 'deliveries only'.

fragments.label: Ventilation Spine
fragments.description: A services drawing tracing the ventilation spine down past the basement. A maintenance stamp marks an access hatch at the sublevel landing.

fragments.label: Freight-Lift Call Sheet
fragments.description: A lift call sheet for the freight car, heat-warped at the edge. The sublevel button is annotated in pen: 'materials — badge or breaker'.

zones.installation_description: A nonpublic junction on the metro's service ring where traction-power rooms, pump controls and a staff refuge share one dry gallery. Public route maps never showed it; the utility's own wiring keys did.

fragments.label: Traction Feed
fragments.description: A traction-power single-line diagram, oil-stained, showing the feed into a junction not on the passenger map.

fragments.label: Pump Gallery
fragments.description: A sump-and-pump arrangement plan for the service ring. A fitter's note across the border: 'gallery stays dry, check the sticks'.

fragments.label: Junction Wiring Key
fragments.description: A wiring key card matching breaker positions to rooms. The exchange junction is tabbed with a strip of masking tape.
